name: Swear Words
overview: Scripture instructs believers to honor God's name and speak with integrity, warning against taking the Lord's name in vain and making false oaths (Exodus 20:7; Matthew 5:33). Our words carry great weight, as Proverbs 13:3 teaches that careful speech preserves life, while careless talk leads to destruction. Jesus emphasizes simple, truthful communication without exaggeration or deceit (Matthew 5:37), and the New Testament exhorts Christians to bless rather than curse others, promoting edifying and gracious speech that benefits listeners (Romans 12:14; Ephesians 4:29). Together, these verses call believers to purity and honesty in all verbal expressions, reflecting Christ's character.
